passage:
A clear bottle stood on the teacher's desk. Every time the class wasted time, the teacher dropped a small stone into it. Every time they worked well, she removed one.
At first, students thought it was a game. Then they noticed the bottle filling up before tests because they talked too much.
The teacher said the stones were not punishment. They were a way to make time visible.
The class began to work faster when they saw many stones inside. By Friday, the bottle was empty.
Students learned that minutes are like small stones. One does not seem heavy, but many together can fill a bottle. Time can be lost in pieces before anyone notices.
